title: AutoToolSwitcher
description: Automatically switches to the best hotbar tool for blocks and hostile mobs.
body:
# 🛠️ Auto Tool Switcher

**Auto Tool Switcher** is a lightweight Fabric mod that helps you pick the right tool automatically.

No more stressful hotbar scrolling while mining, digging, chopping, or fighting.
The mod switches to the best tool for the action you are doing, so you can focus on playing.

## ✨ Features

* Automatically switches tools when breaking blocks
* Automatically switches tools when attacking entities
* Simple and lightweight
* Clean settings menu
* Easy in-game help command
* Built for a smoother survival experience

## ⚙️ Settings

You can easily change how the mod works using the settings menu.

The options are clean, simple, and easy to understand.

Need help in-game?
Use:

```text
/autotoolswitcher help
```

## 🎮 Why use it?

* Faster gameplay
* Less hotbar scrolling
* Better tool handling
* More focus on mining, fighting, and exploring
* Simple setup, no complicated configuration

## 📦 Requirements

* **Fabric Loader**
* **Fabric API**
* **Mod Menu**
* **Cloth Config API**

## ✅ Simple. Lightweight. Useful.

Auto Tool Switcher is made for players who want a smoother Minecraft experience without extra clutter.
